intro: The Institute teaches you to build AI systems. Claude is the model most of that building happens with — in the code lab, in the agent phases, in the capstone. This is the map to learning Claude itself: what we teach in-house, and Anthropic's own free curriculum, which we link to rather than rehost.

ours.title: The Claude Code guide
ours.blurb: A plain-English map of Claude Desktop and Claude Code for people with no coding experience — every feature named, then explained by what it lets you do. Part 5 links Anthropic's official courses.

ours.title: Sikh Code — the agentic dojo
ours.blurb: The real Claude Code command set as a REPL you drive. Type / to explore — each command is its own short lesson, synced to the docs.

academy.name: Anthropic Academy
academy.note: Anthropic's official learning platform. Free; sign-in is through Skilljar and does not need an Anthropic account. Sikhi University is not affiliated with Anthropic — every link here goes straight to their site and nothing is rehosted. “Claude” and “Anthropic” are their trademarks.
